03 — THE CLUB

More than
a gym. A team.

Hutchison Boxing Academy has been part of Loanhead since 2017 — a community club where kids as young as seven train beside adults, and where beginners become boxers. Qualified coaches, a safe and friendly room, and a simple rule: everyone is welcome, no matter your age or ability.

Train for fitness, train for confidence, or train to compete — the choice is yours. The club runs its own home shows at Loanhead Miners Club, streamed live, so the whole town can watch its boxers step through the ropes.

Fight Nights · Loanhead Miners Club

Home shows.
Your town. Your boxers.

The academy stages its own evenings of Olympic-style boxing at Loanhead Miners Club — doors open, lights down, first bell. Family, friends and the whole of Loanhead in the room. Shows are streamed live.
